title: Restrict release version matching to the plugin TOML table
description: Restrict release version matching to the plugin TOML table
no_spec_change_rationale: The CLI v3 contract already requires plugin version parity; this fix makes the existing invariant reject malformed manifests instead of reading another table
acceptance_criteria: The setter and release checker reject a plugin table without its own version even when a later table defines version and neither file is partially rewritten
